regularization_definition: sum historical log likelihood minus 0.5 * 2.0 * squared coefficient norm
refit_schedule: calendar quarter start, using only earlier days

feature_definitions.same_first_letter_past7: Fraction of answers in the previous 7 calendar days sharing the candidate's first letter
feature_definitions.same_last_letter_past7: Fraction of answers in the previous 7 calendar days sharing the candidate's last letter
feature_definitions.same_last2_past7: Fraction of answers in the previous 7 calendar days sharing the candidate's final two letters
feature_definitions.mean_unique_letter_jaccard_past3: Mean Jaccard overlap of unique-letter sets with answers in the previous 3 calendar days
feature_definitions.repeat_fraction_times_recent_shift: Candidate (5-unique_letters)/4 times (past3 mean minus past90 mean of that fraction)
feature_definitions.difficulty_times_recent_shift: Candidate clip(-log10(base_prior)/4,0,1) times (past3 mean minus past90 mean of that difficulty)
feature_definitions.repeat_gap_if_at_least8_seen: Repeat-class only: min(calendar days since latest repeat event,30)/30 - 0.5; zero until 8 prior repeat events
feature_definitions.outside_unused_gap_if_at_least8_seen: Outside-unused-class only: corresponding gap feature; zero until 8 prior outside-unused events

variants.structural: six features within each category, preserving P2 category masses
variants.full: structural tilt plus separately fitted two-feature category softmax

caution: Past-only fitting within an exploratory historical evaluation; log-likelihood gains do not imply fewer guesses.
